name: e-shop
description: E-Shop MERN Application - Unified Workspace Runner

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" --kill-others "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" --kill-others "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run preview"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
